title: Robin (who found the river penny) and Sarel (whose family's die was used) never get a line reacting to the final 'Pennywell's Coin' decision once it's made — only Meva and Doran, the two NPCs actually consulted for the decision, get follow-up dialogue ('the coin, now its face is decided'). The two townsfolk most personally tied to the coin's history are silent on the outcome.
where: The Mint Yard / talk to Robin, and The Hammer Hearth / talk to Sarel, both after 'Pennywell's Coin' quest completion
